report.title: 15 shared-library capacity tables admit no straight line; a-w-S190.012 and a-w-S255.012 author one row at 120 deg
report.detail: Observed: the new read ds dsgrid run --operation structure_capacity_tables --params '{"only_findings":true}' on m2-r18-planpolicy reports angle_domain_excludes_tangent on 15 artifacts and single_angle_knot on 16. Two of them are the ones the owner already suspected: a-w-S190.012 and a-w-S255.012 each author exactly one allowable-span row at 120 deg with outside_domain reject, so those suspensions can never be spotted on tangent -- the planner refuses them at every straight station with AngleOutsideDomain (47 rejections each on one alignment). Others: a-w-S140(1).012 and a-w-S190(1).012 start at 0.5 deg, l-w-S140/S190/S255/S325 at 5 deg, b-w-* at 1 deg, e-w-* at 30 deg, j-w-120d-* at 60 deg. This is a DATA report, not a code report: the code now surfaces it (import receipt warning, capacity_angle_domain_excludes_structure finding on report structures, and the read above). Expected: the canonical library's .012 tables are corrected where the angle domain is wrong -- the owner's rule is that suspensions are 0-0.5 deg -- and the corrected library is re-versioned. Acceptance: structure_capacity_tables --only-findings reports no angle_domain_excludes_tangent for a family the project spots on tangent.
